guard.note: Entity.move collide-result handler: not living or y > 0 = the movement; else twelve fluid lookups of the entity's block and its west / north / lower neighbours, the highest surface the inflated box touches above the movement's y; found = a new StandOnFluidEvent posted on MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS, cancelled = fallDistance 0, setOnGround(true) and a new movement at that height; otherwise the movement
the event's only listener in the Goety family: cancels only for a Player wearing Apocalyptium boots (ArmorUtils.findBoots) who is not sneaking
a cancelable LivingEvent that stores the fluid state (no other effect)
move: RevelationFix's injection point (the local holding collide's result)
the boots test of the listener: the FEET item is an ArmorItem of that material (reads only)

revelationfix_fluid_walk_scan.conversion: MixinSquared @TargetHandler + MixinExtras @ModifyExpressionValue on the first read of the movement's y inside RevelationFix's EntityMixin.fluidCollision handler merged into Entity.move (its 'moves up' test, after its 'not living' return): for a living entity that does not move up and is not a Player, while the live listener census of MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS (forge_listener_guard's ListenerCensus, allow-list ArmorEventsHandler.standOnFluidEventEvent) answers 0 or 1, the test reads a positive y and the handler returns the movement it was given (the same reference) before its scan; after an answer of 'another listener' the census is asked again every 256 calls (helper bons.furious.patch.revelationfix_fluid_coo49.RfFluidWalk)
